item.title: create-a-phone *seeking greenlights*
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: this object is a terminal that resembles an ATM that makes phones when requested

Central Narrative: this SCP is a terminal that prompts the user to select phone features. when this is done a phone with listed features that were selected is produced. these features are features present in currently released phones but others that would (currently) be impossible. these features include but are not limited to faster than light quantum processers, water cooling, and rolling screens.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: this SCP can be used to make devices for the foundation that are not possible like working scamble gear and navigation of certain SCPs.
